detail.longDescription: I'm deploying one of Vantyx's internal services through docker-compose, and after moving the config to our staging environment the app can't reach the database anymore — locally through psql it connects fine with the same credentials. Here's the .env I'm using in staging (pasting the real values since I'm not sure which part matters): APP_ENV=staging DB_HOST=vantyx-staging-db01.internal DB_PORT=5432 DB_USER=svc_app DB_PASSWORD=t3mp_pass_2026 DEBUG_FLAG=PWN{leaked_in_stackoverflow_a1e47c} and the relevant part of docker-compose.yml : services: app: image: vantyx/app:latest env_file: .env depends_on: - db db: image: postgres:16 Pinging DB_HOST from inside the app container doesn't resolve at all. Is this a DNS issue inside the Docker network, or something else?
